description: The shape scope of Multi-brand: its answers, its usage rules and the semantic tokens it owns. The loader joins it with scheme.json.

answers.question: shape.count
answers.why: Two corner sizes: one for controls and badges, and a larger one for containers, as Aster's 4px and 8px corners show.

answers.question: shape.definition
answers.why: Each brand sets its own corners.

answers.question: shape.values
answers.why: Rounded by default; each brand sets its own corner.

answers.question: shape.lands
answers.why: Corners are the most visible brand difference.

usage.why: Each brand sets its own corner through the theme.
The brand sets the badge shape.
(set by the brand). Each brand sets the option corner, and it nests inside that brand's menu corner.

One thin edge serves every brand. Color carries the brand, not line weight.

usage.not: A ring that touches the control
usage.why: The gap sits around a ring of focus.ring.width. The ring and its gap stay the same in every brand, so focus shows on any brand color.

badge.$description: Corner of badges, chips, tooltips, keyboard keys (kbd) and checkboxes: small labels and marks.

option.$description: Corner of options in menus and lists: the panel's corner less its padding, so the corners nest.

element.$description: Corner of an element that holds content and can grow past one line: a list item, an accordion row, a text area, a calendar, an attachment, a skeleton or media.

surface.$description: Corner of cards, menus and dialogs.

open-ds.why: We use a 1px default line for card borders in every brand in order to give grouping to plans and offers. A thin stroke does this by drawing a shared region with the least weight that still reads, the same in each brand. So color carries each brand, not line weight, because cards separate groups (elevation.definition) and AA holds in every brand (accessibility.definition).

border-width.default.headline: One thin line.
border-width.default.line: Edges stay quiet, so the content leads.

radius.badge.headline: Small marks.
radius.badge.line: Badges keep a small corner in every brand.

radius.control.headline: The brand's corner.
radius.control.line: Each brand sets how round its buttons are.

radius.element.headline: Items that grow.
radius.element.line: Rows and fields follow the brand's corner.

radius.option.headline: Corners that nest.
radius.option.line: Options fit inside the brand's menu corner.

radius.surface.headline: The brand's panel shape.
radius.surface.line: Each brand sets how round its cards are.
